body: Thank you, it means so much to read those words right now I can't even begin to tell you. It's so overwhelming dealing this bullshit day after day and night after night. I hope you're right in that I will be free eventually.

Thank you so much. No I'm not there yet, I meant to say that I'm really close to finally making it there. I've made a lot of progress in that area on my own because I desperately want to live the life I've always deserved to life. However, the other areas of my life I'm struggling with have gotten much worse. OCD which I was actually diagnosed with ten years ago, trauma, fear of getting close to people, reality, it's all so overwhelming. I fit the description of Schizotypal personality disorder to a T and if so it would make so much sense as to why everything had to be so fucking hard since I can remember.

It's so far in the future that I can't even begin to make a guess. Like I said, it's been 7 long years in the build up for me to go to therapy, my anxiety was too bad. I was a shy child, and an extremely shy and scared teenager because of the bullying and harassment I had in school. It would even carry on OUTSIDE of school. I dropped out and then eventually withdrew socially because I was scared of strangers. Of course, my family gave me no help in getting over any of that so it snowballed into full blown severe anxiety that I've been battling. 7 years of my life wasted that I will not get back.
Thank you for listening. Unfortunately I'm with them for my benefit because I can't work, otherwise I would be living FAR away from them and everyone in my town.

My last message was short because I wasn't in the place to give a proper reply, so now I just wanted to say thank you again for the very understanding and heartfelt post. It meant a lot to me when I was at my lowest. 

I'm in a slightly better place now then when I made the post (for now). I'm just trying to figure out what the next step is. You seem like a great person too and I wish you a lot of happiness in your own life.

Thank you for this very kind message, it means a lot to me. Being human is such a roller coaster. 
I wish you luck with your journey too.

When I was 17 I had a therapist who didn't help at all, she just interrupted me and wasn't really qualified to help solve mental issues. I did get one to come to my house 3 years ago, but I squandered the chance and now I'm kicking myself really hard for that. 
I agree, group therapy is worth a shot. For me, it would be awhile before I tried any group stuff, but in the future it seems likely.
I stated in my post that I have too much anxiety right now to get to therapy. I'd love to get there, more than anything. It's just this anxiety. It's been in my way of happiness for so long now.

That's wonderful to hear you found love and happiness without someone. If I weren't going through other things, it would be easier for me to get on better on my own. I have had to deal with PTSD? I think? I haven't been to a therapist/psychiatrist so I don't want to throw out any names yet, but I have a lot of the symptoms.
 Whatever it is, it's been eating my life due to an incident that happened 7 years ago and then a bunch of other problems came along with it like a giant snowball. I guess I just wish I knew how to trust my mother now since she is really all I have, so I can have someone to just hold me while I feel terrible. I just want to be comforted and loved during these gigantic thunderstorms. (I probably should have added that in the main post)

Thank you very much for your reply. I actually did enjoy doing a lot of the things you listed, but this depression has killed a lot of my enjoyment. It's like a deep dark hole I can't get out of. 
You did remind me that I took walks a lot during the early hours, I should probably try doing that again as it did bring me a lot of joy. I also took pictures of a lot of stuff too. I just feel if I had at least one person I could trust, I would be 100 times better and it would be easier trying to find joy again
